notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken noncreature artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scrap Trawler and Salvaging Station trigger.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
